veranderings.voor: Die harde dele bly lê of die vorm
veranderings.na: Die harde dele bly lê, of die vorm
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: a comma before 'of' when it joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Die laag word later hard, en
veranderings.na: Die laag het later hard geword, en
veranderings.rede: The surrounding sentences narrate the past ('was eens los sand', 'toegemaak het'), so the present 'word later hard' jars; past tense keeps the sequence consistent without changing the meaning.
